title: Settlement Basis for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Cancellation Penalty Withheld on a Given-Up Booking
content:
The cancellation penalty withheld from a booking sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands that the traveller has given up is worked out for one traveller and then taken for the party. Two figures are named in what follows: **the penalty owed for one traveller**, and **the penalty withheld**.

**1. The penalty owed for one traveller.** It is the flat cancellation penalty of the fare brand held, taken in full.

**2. The charge for the party.** The penalty owed for one traveller is charged once for the booking. The penalty owed for one traveller is settled in full before it is taken for the party, and the figure that party charge gives is the penalty withheld, each share and each uplift that bears on a figure acting in turn on the figure the one before it gives, so that the figure runs on from one step to the next and is never reached by measuring them separately against the figure as it was settled and netting the results together.

**3. Which figure a thing enters.** Anything owed in dollars for one traveller enters the penalty owed for one traveller, and within that figure a share is taken on the flat cancellation penalty before anything is added to it in dollars. Anything taken as a share of the penalty as a whole acts on the penalty withheld.

**4. Where several bear on one figure.** Where more than one share is taken on the same figure, the shares act one after another, each on the figure the one before it gives, and are never combined into a single rate; where more than one uplift is added to the same figure, the uplifts are combined into a single uplift and the figure is increased once by that total.

**5. The line it is raised against.** The penalty is raised against the base-fare line posted earliest on the booking, and the penalty line carries the traveller position of the base-fare line it is raised against.

**6. The money collected on the booking.** This is the total of the booking's fare, tax and service lines, its optional extras, its rework lines and its penalty lines. The travel credit the booking has issued or redeemed never enters that total.

**7. The value the ticket still carries.** This is the money collected on the booking less the agency service fee of the fare brand held for each traveller on it. The penalty withheld is never larger than the value the ticket still carries, and that ceiling is applied to the penalty withheld as it finally stands.

**8. Rounding.** The amount withheld is rounded to two decimal places at the end and never at any intermediate step.

**Worked determination on hypothetical figures.** Every figure and every rate in what follows is hypothetical, chosen only to show the whole chain being carried, and no rate below is a published one. Take a booking carrying one traveller, on a fare brand whose flat cancellation penalty is hypothetically 100.00 US dollars and whose agency service fee is hypothetically 20.00 US dollars. The penalty owed for one traveller settles first, and it settles at the flat cancellation penalty taken in full, that is 100.00 US dollars. Suppose a share of 0.64 is taken on that flat cancellation penalty: 100.00 taken at 0.64 gives 64.00. Suppose an uplift of 0.25 then bears on the figure that share gave: 64.00 increased by 0.25 gives 80.00. Suppose 9.00 US dollars is then owed in dollars for the one traveller, which enters this figure after the share: 80.00 with 9.00 added gives 89.00, so the penalty owed for one traveller settles at 89.00 US dollars. That settled figure is then charged once for the booking, so the penalty the party charge gives is 89.00 US dollars. Suppose a share of 0.94 is taken on the penalty as a whole: it acts on the figure the party charge gave, so 89.00 taken at 0.94 gives 83.66, and the penalty withheld stands at 83.66 US dollars. Each step is worked on the figure the step before it gave. The booking shows a fare line of 500.00 US dollars, a tax line of 60.00 US dollars, a service line of 20.00 US dollars, an optional extra of 40.00 US dollars and a rework line of 20.00 US dollars, so the money collected on the booking is 640.00 US dollars; a travel credit of 75.00 US dollars issued on the booking is left out of that total. The value the ticket still carries is 640.00 US dollars less 20.00 US dollars for the one traveller, that is 620.00 US dollars. The penalty withheld of 83.66 US dollars is not larger than 620.00 US dollars, so the ceiling does not bite, and the amount withheld, rounded to two decimal places, is 83.66 US dollars.

**The ceiling biting, on hypothetical figures.** Take the same hypothetical flat cancellation penalty of 100.00 US dollars, the same hypothetical agency service fee of 20.00 US dollars and the same hypothetical chain as above, on a booking carrying one traveller where the money collected on the booking is 90.00 US dollars. The penalty owed for one traveller settles at 100.00 US dollars, carried through the hypothetical share of 0.64 to 64.00, through the hypothetical uplift of 0.25 to 80.00 and through the hypothetical 9.00 US dollars owed in dollars to 89.00; charged once for the booking that gives 89.00 US dollars, and the hypothetical share of 0.94 on the penalty as a whole leaves the penalty withheld standing at 83.66 US dollars. The value the ticket still carries is 70.00 US dollars, and since the penalty is never larger than that value, the amount withheld, rounded to two decimal places, is 70.00 US dollars.
